test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the word 'consensus' from the following sentence.**

The landowner and the tenant mutually came to an agreement for decisive acceptance of its clause.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Agreement".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ​A word that is **synonymous** with another word is known as a **synonym** (or nearly the same meaning).
 
• **Consensus** is the **general agreement on something**.
 
 
• **Example: ***The two neighbours have reached a **consensus.***
 
 
 
• In the sentence, **Agreement** is the act of **reaching a mutual understanding or agreement**.
 
 
• **Example: ***They have signed an **agreement** for the property.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, we can consider the word **"Agreement" **as the synonym of **" consensus"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's have a look at other options.

 
 

 **Words**
 **Meaning**
 
 

 **Decisive**
 having or showing the ability to make decisions quickly and effectively.
 
 

 **Acceptance**
 the property of being seen as acceptable or suitable.
 
 

 **Mutually**
 something shared by two or more individuals or groups.
 
 

 

 
• The above meanings are not matching with the word **'consensus'**. So they are not the correct answer.
